import os,json,stat,tempfile,urllib.request,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
release=root/'releases/0a1a4c190a7d33752d6dc3f4418ed44735c8a7dd'
sha='e443b2161f88fd9228335f3d681ee52858a78d48'
paths=['engine/tool_runtime.py','engine/tool_actions.json','engine/catalog.json']
result={'mode':'Ferrari-release-delta-sync','source_commit':sha,'status':'BLOCKED','paths':[]}
saved={}; changed=[]
try:
 assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and release.is_dir()
 assert (root/'tools/android-cli-36.0.0/build-tools/36.0.0/aapt2').is_file()
 payload={}
 for name in paths:
  url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal/'+sha+'/'+name
  blob=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20).read(130000)
  assert blob and len(blob)>1000
  if name.endswith('.py'):
   import ast;ast.parse(blob.decode())
   assert b'android-cli-36.0.0' in blob
  else:
   j=json.loads(blob);assert j.get('schema')==1
   if 'tool_actions' in name:assert len(j['actions'])==40
  dest=release/name
  assert dest.is_file() and not dest.is_symlink()
  saved[name]=(dest.read_bytes(),dest.stat())
  payload[name]=blob
 for name,data in payload.items():
  dest=release/name;old,st=saved[name]
  fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.ferrari-delta-',dir=str(dest.parent))
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as out:out.write(data);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
  os.chmod(temp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode));os.chown(temp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid)
  os.replace(temp,dest);changed.append(name)
  result['paths'].append({'file':name,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
 check=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sudo','-n','-H','-u','ubuntu','/usr/bin/python3','-m','engine.ferrari','actions'],cwd=str(release),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
 result['runtime_exit']=check.returncode
 if check.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('Ferrari action inventory failed: '+check.stderr[-280:])
 actions=json.loads(check.stdout)
 for name in ('android-apksigner-verify','android-aapt2-manifest','android-zipalign-apk','android-adb-install-apk'):
  v=next((x for x in actions if x['action']==name),None)
  if not v or not v['available']:raise RuntimeError('Android action not callable: '+name)
 result['registered_actions']=len(actions)
 result['status']='SYNCED_AND_CALLABLE'
except Exception as e:
 result['error']=type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:240]
 for name in reversed(changed):
  old,st=saved[name];dest=release/name
  fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.ferrari-rollback-',dir=str(dest.parent))
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as out:out.write(old);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
  os.chmod(temp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode));os.chown(temp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid);os.replace(temp,dest)
 result['status']='ROLLED_BACK' if changed else 'BLOCKED'
print(json.dumps(result))
